text:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate observed on embeddings route (us-west-2). Auto-escalation to oncall. Impact: elevated 5xx for /v1/embeddings - P0.

maria: I'm on pager. grabbing graphs now. @alex @ken pls ping if you see customer tickets.

alex: joining — quick check: embeddings QPS spike from ~12k -> ~40k in last 6m, CPU on embed-workers at 95%, a few cache nodes showing KV eviction. chat and rerank routes look normal latency-wise.

sara-support: support queue: 2 enterprise customers and 3 self-serve teams reporting 5xx on embeddings, not chat. customers showing timeouts in client logs.

maria: hypothesis = noisy embeddings clients + prefix cache misses. plan options: 1) soft-throttle embeddings for free-tier, 2) temporarily tighten per-endpoint qps limits for global embeddings route, 3) route high-volume customers to dedicated capacity if available. prefer 2 + 3 for fastest impact.

ken: I can apply a route-specific qps override. Suggest: reduce default embeddings route qps from 120 -> 40 qps in us-west-2 and add an explicit allowlist for paid/dedicated customers. Also spin down non-critical background embed jobs.

alex: +1 for route override. I can take the console change: Admin -> Quotas -> Route Overrides. Will also create a short-lived rule to reject requests exceeding the new per-endpoint limit with a friendly 429 body so clients can backoff.

maria: execute it. I'll notify support to update customers. I'm going to page infra to prepare a dedicated-fallback mapping for two flagged customers.

alex: applied override: per_route:embeddings.us-west-2.qps = 40 (effective now). Failures should convert to 429 for excess clients. Logged change ID: CHG-6142.

sara-support: confirmed receipts: one enterprise saw error rate drop from 30% -> 6% after throttles, but another still seeing ~12% — likely stuck behind throttled clients; investigating customer-level routing.

ken: I'm carving a route-specific limit for customer-c-123 as emergency: set qps 120 -> 10 and map them to a retry policy. Will also temporarily disable non-essential rerank scoring for that tenant to free up capacity.

alex: note: disabled rerank-heavy transform (feature flag: rerank-scoring-heavy) for tenant c-123. Metrics should settle in 2-3 min.

maria: handing off incident to alex for live mitigation and post-incident doc. I'm going to pull primary pager duty rotation. Key actions taken: reduced embeddings default qps, created allowlist for paid customers, disabled heavy rerank for one tenant, support notified, CHG-6142 recorded.

alex: taking over. I'll keep the thread updated and run impact assessment. next steps: 1) validate error rate across all tenants, 2) open follow-up ticket to rebalance quota model (short-term: more granular per-route caps), 3) recommend traffic-shift playbook to route noisy clients to dedicated pools.

sara-support: flagging impacted account ids + logs in the ticket. customers want ETA for full restore. any ETA?

alex: ETA: if current mitigations hold, we expect customer-facing error rates to be stable in ~15-30m. I'll escalate to infra if CPU doesn't drop in 10m.

maria: thanks team. leaving for an urgent page; alex now primary. I'll update later with follow-up notes. :thumbsup:
